outputs.explanation: Spatial transcriptomics cluster image (micrograph-type tissue image), not a plot of averaged data.
H&E tissue images with manual region annotations; not a plot showing averages.
H&E image and spatial expression heatmap-style overlays on tissue sections; not a bar/summary plot of averaged data, so individual points are not applicable.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; overlaying individual points would make them unreadable and is not required.

Bar graph shows single computed log2 fold-change values per gene from differential expression testing (with associated p-values), not means/medians of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.
